neighbours.label: Christian evangelism / discipleship mission language (making disciples, preaching the gospel, hearing God's call)
fire: Our church exists to make disciples who share the gospel with every neighbor.
The missionaries spent ten years preaching the good news of Christ in remote villages.
We are called to evangelize the lost and lead them to a personal encounter with Jesus.
The ministry trains young believers to become bold witnesses for the Lord.
Every member is encouraged to spread the Word and win souls for Christ.
Her outreach team plants new congregations and disciples converts across the region.
The pastor urged the youth to listen for God's call and carry the gospel abroad.
As a mission-minded church, we send teams to proclaim salvation through Jesus.
quiet: Our company exists to build tools that help every neighbor save energy.
The volunteers spent ten years teaching reading skills in remote villages.
We are called to serve the hungry and connect them with local food banks.
The program trains young engineers to become confident leaders in their field.
Every member is encouraged to recycle more and reduce waste at home.
Her outreach team opens new clinics and trains nurses across the region.
The coach urged the youth to listen to their bodies and train carefully.
As a community-minded firm, we send teams to rebuild homes after storms.

notes: Card: top examples are function words ('to', ',', 'a') inside church mission statements; near misses are secular mission statements of the same shape.
